evidence: The supplied issue #877 explicitly requires no conflict markers to remain before creating the WIP merge commit.
scripts/task_run/task_run_git.py::_merge_state checks only `git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U`. Staging a conflicted file removes its unmerged index entries even when its conflict markers remain.

scripts/task_run/task_run_checkpoint.py::_checkpoint_interrupted_lane treats an empty conflicted list as resolved and, when dirty paths are in scope, invokes _commit_merge_candidate. That helper stages everything and commits without checking file content.

Concrete counterexample: create a conflicting merge affecting an in-scope file, run `git add` on that file without removing its conflict markers, then end the lane abnormally. The supplied implementation creates a merge candidate instead of reporting `unresolved merge in progress`.
